page.overview:
Who is Emi?

Emi has long, straight black hair and large, dark-brown eyes. She wore a short, strapless blue dress with two thin gold belts wrapped around it, along with a pair of black strap-on heels, dangling earrings and an intricate necklace.

On a trip to Shukuba Town to visit her friends, she falls prey to one of Itachi Uchiha's genjutsu. Itachi had her draw the attention of Jiraiya so that he could get to Naruto Uzumaki. Jiraiya, realising that Emi did not usually show interest in him, freed her from the genjutsu and went to save Naruto.
